info.description: Jina embeddings and reranking served via the AIsa relay (OpenAI-compatible) path. Includes text embeddings (jina-embeddings-v3 and jina-embeddings-v5-text-small, both 1024-dim) and document reranking (jina-reranker-v3). Billing is token-based for both endpoints.
info.title: Jina Embeddings & Rerank API

post.description: Generate embedding vectors for one or more input strings using jina-embeddings-v3 or jina-embeddings-v5-text-small (both 1024-dim output). OpenAI-compatible request and response. Served via the AIsa relay path /v1/embeddings. Billing is token-based.

input.description: A non-empty string, or an array of non-empty strings, to embed.

model.description: Embedding model name. Available: jina-embeddings-v3 or jina-embeddings-v5-text-small (both 1024-dim).

post.description: Rerank a list of documents against a query using jina-reranker-v3, returning documents ordered by relevance score. Served via the AIsa relay path /v1/rerank. Billing is token-based.

documents: Paris is the capital of France.
Berlin is the capital of Germany.
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
example.query: What is the capital of France?

documents.description: Non-empty array of document strings to rerank.
example: Paris is the capital of France.
Berlin is the capital of Germany.
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.

query.description: Non-empty query string to rank documents against.
query.example: What is the capital of France?

top_n.description: Optional. Return only the top N most relevant documents.

document.text: Paris is the capital of France.
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.

text.example: Paris is the capital of France.

index.description: Index of the document in the original request array.
